source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 17 May 1967, p. 7 (rural council nominations: Lisburn)
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: Read on the page image of the News-Letter's list of the Lisburn rural division nominations, which prints 'Magheragall - John M'Murty' among the unopposed returns.

note: Triennial election for the 21 seats, polled Thursday 1 June 1967. Eleven divisions were contested and ten were filled unopposed. Returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Re-cited from the page image of the Belfast News-Letter, 17 May 1967, p. 7 (w8-review, Nov 2026): the page cited before (Belfast News-Letter, 2 May 1967, p. 2) does not name him; the News-Letter's unopposed list prints 'Magheragall - John M'Murty'. The name keeps the McMurtry spelling of the 1949-61 notices (the News-Letter drops a letter).
